events.title: Microsoft and OpenAI extend partnership
events.label: Reported
events.evidence_quote: It extends our ongoing collaboration across AI supercomputing and research and enables each of us to independently commercialize the resulting advanced AI technologies.

events.title: Google AI updates: Bard and new AI features in Search
events.label: Reported
events.evidence_quote: We've been working on an experimental conversational AI service, powered by LaMDA, that we're calling Bard.

events.title: Introducing Microsoft 365 Copilot - your copilot for work
events.label: Reported
events.evidence_quote: Today, we are bringing the power of next-generation AI to work.

events.title: Introducing Gemini: Google's most capable AI model yet
events.label: Reported
events.evidence_quote: Today, we're a step closer to this vision as we introduce Gemini, the most capable and general model we've ever built.

events.title: Introducing Gemini 1.5, Google's next-generation AI model
events.label: Reported
events.evidence_quote: Today, we're announcing our next-generation model: Gemini 1.5.

events.title: Introducing Copilot+ PCs
events.label: Reported
events.evidence_quote: Today, at a special event on our new Microsoft campus, we introduced the world to a new category of Windows PCs designed for AI, Copilot+ PCs.

events.title: Google introduces Gemini 2.0: A new AI model for the agentic era
events.label: Reported
events.evidence_quote: Today we're excited to launch our next era of models built for this new agentic era: introducing Gemini 2.0, our most capable model yet.

events.title: Gemini 2.5 Pro update: Coding, web apps with Gemini
